target_customer: Companies building voice and chat AI agents in healthcare, banking, logistics, recruitment and retail, plus conversational AI platforms
problem: Voice and chat agents fail unpredictably in production and teams lack automated testing, simulation and monitoring.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for testing and observability of conversational agents

founders.name: Tarush Agarwal
prior_employers: Quantitative finance firms (ultra low latency systems, three years)
education: IIT Bombay, computer science and statistics

founders.name: Shashij Gupta
education: ETH Zurich research work on testing transformers

founders.name: Sidhant Kabra
prior_employers: Management consulting (FMCG and medical devices clients)
Edtech startup that grew to 200K+ users

technical_complexity.rationale: Simulating realistic callers, scoring voice agent conversations and monitoring live calls across many vendor platforms is standard engineering with hard evaluation problems; the founders have NLP and testing research backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with voice platforms and CI pipelines create some stickiness, but several rivals (Hamming, Coval, Bluejay, Roark) offer the same simulation and monitoring idea.

incumbents: voice agent platforms such as Retell and Vapi
takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy by incumbents found; many direct startup competitors appeared in 2024 and 2025.

market_need_then: Companies were rapidly deploying voice and chat agents in 2024 and needed pre-production testing and production monitoring; the company reports 75+ customers.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and speed focused: 'The reliability layer for voice agents', 'Launch in minutes, not weeks'

branding.brand_signature: The reliability layer for voice agents tagline

rebrands.why: Not confirmed by a primary source; one low quality review site says it was to avoid confusion with an older healthcare communications brand. Rename date is inconsistent across sources.

brand_strength.rationale: Invented name that required a rename from Vocera and is easy to misspell; no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Cekura was founded by three IIT Bombay graduates with quant and NLP research backgrounds and joined YC in Fall 2024. It announced a $2.4M seed round in mid 2025 led by YC and reports 75+ customers across several industries. It renamed from Vocera. The market is crowded with direct testing competitors, but no shutdown or acquisition was found.
notes: Seed amount confirmed by the company blog, Call Centre Helper and American Bazaar. Extruct lists a $200M raise in 2021, an obvious error, ignored. Competitors found (Hamming, Coval, Bluejay, Roark) came from 2025 and 2026 comparison pages with no dates near the Fall 2024 batch, so the list is empty. Legal entity is reported as Tatva Labs Inc.
